invariant_feasible_set_theorem: An S4-invariant subset of a transitive S4-set is either empty or the entire six-axis set; hence invariant exact post-credit alone cannot yield a singleton.
no_go_proof: At an S4-fixed local state s, equivariance gives f(s)=f(g.s)=g.f(s) for every g. A unique selected axis would therefore be a global S4 fixed point, but none exists in the transitive six-axis set.
